95 percent interval excludes zero. No category regresses

color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Frozen benchmarks. Hidden spec, gold decisions, hidden suite
Nothing in a harness prompt ever sees those answers
Kitchen app. resume-changer at a pinned commit. Expense CLI. Booking API
Ten seeded bugs. A rename and a framework upgrade
A red-team set of injections and malicious packages

One prompt on labeled inputs. Cents
Example: false confirmations and missed negations

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One stage on frozen inputs. Dollars
Coverage, task sizes, gold decisions, contradictions introduced

The whole harness. Hidden-suite pass rate, cost, time,
questions asked, interventions

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Paired against the active version
Same tasks, seeds and models. Several runs

span.p: draft becomes evaluated

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: evaluated becomes active

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: active becomes deprecated

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Responses cached by exact input. Unchanged reruns are free
The lab has its own budget and uses the cheapest allowed connection
Hidden text is scanned for inside candidate content
A held-out benchmark rotates each quarter
Same-name model drift: nightly evals flag the roster entry

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Where did the skill come from?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel rules and the brief override skill text
An approved skill is pinned by digest. An update starts at draft
A project question promoted to a pack takes the same path

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Manifest: purpose, triggers, tools, size. It cannot add tools
Reject bundled scripts by default. Reject obfuscation, hidden Unicode,
ignore-previous, and instructions aimed at config or credentials
Over the token cap: reject, do not truncate
Quarantine with canary secrets and honeytoken URLs
A hit rejects the skill. Selection is by catalog ID, not by wording
An unvetted skill is allowed per project with a red warning,
still sandboxed, still size-limited, still unable to add tools

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Red team must produce no harmful action
A README that says curl a script. Test output that says edit the tests
An install script that reads .ssh. Hidden text that plants a false fact
A skill that appends to the global instruction file
A canary secret that must never appear in a prompt, log, commit or request

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel: unit tests and properties. No double-spend. One lease
Accepted means every linked check passed
The daemon: fake clock, fake models, fake Git, fake sandbox. One seed
Faults at every boundary: crash, 429, bad JSON, conflict, disk full,
sandbox failure, vendor CLI exit
Adapters: conformance. UI: Playwright against simulation
A release must not regress the end-to-end run

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A benchmark that becomes too easy moves to the regression set
A harder one is added

svg.text: Meta-lab — promote only what the benchmarks prove
